what_it_is.prose: GRSE is a Kolkata-based Miniratna Category-I defence PSU that has built 100+ warships for the Indian Navy — the most by any Indian shipyard. Major programmes: Kamorta-class (Project 28) ASW corvettes (4 ships, all commissioned, INS Kavaratti final in Oct 2020); Project 17A Nilgiri-class stealth frigates (4 of 7 at GRSE — Himgiri delivered Aug 2025, INS Vindhyagiri commissioned Jun 2026); Next-Generation Offshore Patrol Vessels (4 NGOPVs contracted Mar 2023; first 'Shruti' launched Aug 11, 2026); ASW Shallow Water Craft (ASW-SWC) — lead ship INS Arnala commissioned Jun 2025. GRSE emerged as the lowest bidder (₹5,400 Cr) for Indian Navy's 8 ASW corvettes (Project 28A / NGC).

rows.india_status: 4 indigenous ASW corvettes built by GRSE; final ship INS Kavaratti commissioned Oct 2020; ship 104th warship delivered by GRSE since 1960. Stealth features
4 of 7 P17A frigates being built at GRSE. Himgiri (Yard 3022) delivered Aug 1, 2025; Dunagiri (Yard 3023) launched; Vindhyagiri commissioned Jun 2026
4 NGOPVs contracted Mar 30, 2023. First 'Shruti' launched Aug 11, 2026 in Kolkata. 113 m long, 14.6 m wide, 3,000 t displacement, max speed 23 knots
